items.title: Ready for your busiest morning
items.text: More room on a holiday Saturday and a powder-day rush on the online shop, the first sale of the day as quick as the rest, and a status page that shows how Verdynt/OS is running.

items.title: Keep selling when the internet drops
items.text: The ticket window, rental counter and ski school desk keep selling cash and card-reader sales if the lodge loses its connection, print receipts, and catch everything up in order as soon as it is back.

items.title: Bring your data with you, and take it with you
items.text: Upload what your old system or spreadsheets export, such as customers, pass holders, products, staff and the rental fleet. Verdynt/OS matches the columns, flags duplicates and problems, and shows a preview before anything is saved. Download everything your mountain holds in one file whenever you want.

items.title: Sales tax the way your area charges it
items.text: More than one tax on a sale, such as state, county and local rates, different rates for lodging or rentals, and tax-exempt sales to schools and government groups.

items.title: Sales into QuickBooks Online
items.text: Each day's sales, refunds, payments and tax go to QuickBooks Online, mapped to your own accounts, instead of being typed in.

items.title: Season pass payment plans and renewals
items.text: Sell a pass with a deposit and monthly payments taken automatically, a renewal price for last season's pass holders, and family pricing for passes bought together.

items.title: Pass revenue over the season
items.text: A schedule that spreads season pass sales across the days of the season, for your accountant and your books.

items.title: Sign in with your company login
items.text: Staff sign in with your Microsoft or Google work account, and owners build their own access levels for every app, the way the patrol director already can in Patrol.

items.title: Guest pages anyone can use
items.text: The online shop, waivers, program registration and lesson booking work with a keyboard and a screen reader, with an accessibility statement you can share.

items.title: This season against last
items.text: Visits, sales, lessons and incidents side by side with the same day last season, with revenue per visit and labor cost against sales.

items.title: Café and retail sales from Square or Toast
items.text: Food, drink and shop sales from Square or Toast appear in Money next to tickets and lessons, so the day adds up in one place.

items.title: Pay rates and hours into your payroll
items.text: Pay rates for each job, labor cost as the day goes, daily overtime where your state requires it, and approved hours sent to your payroll service instead of a spreadsheet.

items.title: Reload a card online, straight to the lift
items.text: Guests with a lift card buy their day online and go straight to the lift, without stopping at the window.

items.title: Tickets in Apple and Google Wallet
items.text: Guests add their ticket or pass to their phone's wallet and scan it at the lift.

items.title: Work with your lift gates
items.text: Tickets and passes sold in Verdynt/OS open the turnstiles many mountains already have, starting with one of the major gate makers.

items.title: One company, several mountains
items.text: One login across your mountains, products and pass holders shared between them, a pass that works at sister mountains, and reports across all of them.

items.title: Connect your other systems
items.text: An API, event notifications and a data feed for the reporting tools you already use.

items.title: Lift inspections by lift type
items.text: Daily, weekly and annual checks that match each lift, from a detachable chair to a surface lift, with operator training, evacuation drills and your state inspector's records in one place.

items.title: Rides and downtime by lift
items.text: Rides, uphill capacity used and wait times from gate scans, and every stop with its reason for the season report.

items.title: Snowmaking and grooming
items.text: Which guns ran on which trails, the water and power used and what each foot of snow cost, plus the night's grooming plan and machine hours.

items.title: Visitor forecast
items.text: How busy the next 10 days will be, as a range, from the day of the week, holidays and school breaks, new snow, the weather forecast and the tickets already sold.

items.title: Morning brief and snow report
items.text: One short read for managers each morning, and the day's conditions update written for your website, email and social media from lifts, trails, grooming and new snow.

items.title: Suggested prices
items.text: Price ideas for busy and quiet days, and better prices for guests who buy ahead, based on how fast tickets are selling.

items.title: Hiring seasonal staff
items.text: An application form, the paperwork checklist, visa sponsorship dates, housing assignments and a rehire list, so each new hire is ready before their first shift.

items.title: Training records for every team
items.text: Required training and certifications for lift operators, groomers, instructors and every other team, checked when shifts are scheduled.

items.title: Safety program
items.text: Near misses, safety meetings and job hazard reviews for every department, next to the staff injury register.

items.title: Guest accounts and alerts
items.text: Guests keep their family, passes and a saved card in one account, and get a text when a lift is on hold or a lesson moves for weather.

items.title: Group sales and charge accounts
items.text: Invoices and accounts for school groups, ski clubs and company days, paid later.

items.title: Summer operations
items.text: Bike park, scenic rides and other summer activities sold by time slot with a limit, the right waiver for each activity, and bike rentals.

items.title: Canada
items.text: Canadian dollars and taxes, French, and metric units.

items.title: Staff screens in Spanish
items.text: The time clock, schedules and staff pages in Spanish for the staff who read it first.

items.title: Patrol on the map
items.text: See where patrollers are on the map during a call.

items.title: Season-end survey help
items.text: The visits, lifts and injury figures the industry's end-of-season survey asks for, gathered for you.
